# TinyWow Now

> Free online tools for images, PDFs, videos, files and text. Every tool runs in the visitor's web browser, so files are processed on the user's own device and are not uploaded. No sign-up, no watermark.

## Key facts
- Price: free, no account needed
- Privacy: files are processed locally in the browser and are never uploaded to a server
- Popular tool: image compressor for JPG, PNG and WebP at https://www.tinywownow.com/compress-image
- Number of tools: 53
- Contact: tinywownow@gmail.com

## PDF Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://www.tinywownow.com/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one
- [Split PDF](https://www.tinywownow.com/split-pdf): Split a PDF into separate pages
- [Compress PDF](https://www.tinywownow.com/compress-pdf): Shrink scanned or image-heavy PDFs
- [OCR PDF](https://www.tinywownow.com/ocr-pdf): Make scanned PDFs searchable and copyable
- [PDF to Word](https://www.tinywownow.com/pdf-to-word): Extract PDF text into an editable Word file
- [PDF to JPG](https://www.tinywownow.com/pdf-to-jpg): Convert each PDF page to a JPG image
- [JPG to PDF](https://www.tinywownow.com/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG images into a PDF file
- [Word to PDF](https://www.tinywownow.com/word-to-pdf): Turn the text of a Word file into a PDF
- [PDF to PNG](https://www.tinywownow.com/pdf-to-png): Convert PDF pages to PNG images
- [PDF to Excel](https://www.tinywownow.com/pdf-to-excel): Pull simple tables from PDF into Excel
- [Excel to PDF](https://www.tinywownow.com/excel-to-pdf): Convert Excel spreadsheets to PDF
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.tinywownow.com/rotate-pdf): Rotate PDF pages to any angle
- [Watermark PDF](https://www.tinywownow.com/watermark-pdf): Add custom watermark text to PDF
- [PDF to Text](https://www.tinywownow.com/pdf-to-text): Extract all text content from PDF
- [Sign PDF](https://www.tinywownow.com/sign-pdf): Draw your signature and place it on a PDF
- [PDF to PPT](https://www.tinywownow.com/pdf-to-ppt): Turn PDF pages into PowerPoint slides

## Blog
- [How to Convert Excel to CSV Without Losing Data](https://www.tinywownow.com/blog/convert-excel-to-csv): To convert Excel to CSV, open XLS Converter, add your workbook, choose CSV and download the result. A CSV holds one sheet and stores values instead of formulas, so the tool saves each sheet as its own file. Check dates, formatted numbers and leading zeros before you import the result.
- [How to Compress a Video for Email](https://www.tinywownow.com/blog/compress-video-for-email): To compress a video for email, check your limit first. Gmail allows up to 25 MB of attachments for personal accounts. Then lower the resolution and raise the compression until the file fits with room to spare. Compress Video on TinyWow Now does this in your browser, so your video never uploads.
- [How to Merge PDF Files Without Uploading Them](https://www.tinywownow.com/blog/merge-pdf-without-uploading): To merge PDF files without uploading them, use a tool that runs in your browser, such as Merge PDF, or a program on your own computer. Add your files, set the order, click merge and download merged.pdf. You can prove that nothing uploads by watching the Network tab in your browser developer tools while you merge.
- [How to Compress an Image to 100 KB, 50 KB or 20 KB](https://www.tinywownow.com/blog/compress-image-to-100kb): To get a photo under 100 KB, crop it and reduce its width to about 1,000 to 1,200 pixels. Then save it as a JPG at roughly 70 to 80 percent quality. Cutting pixels does most of the work, and lowering quality alone rarely shrinks a phone photo that far without visible damage. The Compress Image tool on TinyWow Now does this for you. Type a target size such as 100 KB, and the tool finds the best quality that fits. It runs in your browser, so your photo never uploads.
